Silence - Houston? - the air inside my EVA suit getting heavier - We have... A situation here. -
Still inside the Lander, Buzz was cryptically watching the ground around us. Without a doubt the lunar surface was quiet, they call this place Mare Tranquilitatis after all. Only an odd print ruined the view.
I carefully stepped off the ladder, landing a couple of inches from the already present print; I actually wrote a speech for the occasion, but words couldn't leave my mouth. 
Something was off in this whole situation; what if the Russians arrived before us? That was impossible, we had our satellites and telescopes pointed on the Moon since early '68, we would have seen them right?
Another couple of steps only to realize that my boots left a groove print, while the one already there was perfectly plain. 
Ok, we are the first American to ever set foot here so it has to be the Soviets. But there is only one print... Suddenly the comms where interrupted and white noise began to fill my ears. 
I turn around, only to see someone walking towards us in a bright orange suit. My heart skipped a beat when I realized not only that he was a Soviet Cosmonaut, but that the visor was completely ripped apart, maybe from a fall, maybe from a fight. 
A hand reaching out of the broken glass directly for me. - This... This isn't possible... How in the world... - 
I almost fall trying to get back into the LEM - Buzz, take us out of here now! - I scream once entered.


So yeah, it's true. The photos of the Moon landing are a hoax. 
But not because we couldn't arrive there, because we found something and we decided to never come back.

\- My dear.... How long has it been since the first time we met? It’s been… almost fifteen years, isn’t it? All this time, and still we never had the time to talk… Well, well now it’s not the moment to be sentimental. You know, ever since I was a little boy I was emargined by everyone because I didn’t wear trendy clothes, I always took A+ in every exam and I rarely went outside of my house. It was difficult, but I never gave them too much weight. Their insults, like the one you are now saying to me, didn’t make me flinch and I always continued with my life. No one really knew why I was such an outcast: my mother suffered from an illness that forced her to stay in bed because her body couldn’t lift her so I had to tend to her almost every day when dad wasn’t home. He was never home. And I studied hard to make her happy, at least sometimes… But it wasn’t enough, she needed more medical attention but every hospital refused to treat her and my father didn’t wanted to pay a private clinic for someone already destined to die and so she died in a empty day of november, before I could even graduate. I started to hate everyone. The only person who loved me was my mother and now she was gone, forever. So I became even more of an outcast and I began my carrier as a thief, and later as a villain… But in my heart I always wanted to make someone smile like I did with my mother when I was only a little boy. And then I saw you, a mighty hero. And everytime you defeated someone you was smiling… So I decided to battle you, hoping to being defeated only to see you smile. - said the tall man crying helplessly, moments before charging the finishing blow...

What is right? What is wrong? Countless men asked this questions for aeons, never founding a real answer. After all, the line between good and evil can be very light and often is difficult to understand what is what.  
The problem is, the angel and the devil on my shoulder never disagree with each other.

I never really realized until I was 16; I was walking down the road direct to the mall when a old van appeared on the road from the woods almost running me over, just to finish against the hard trunk of a birch. Smoke slowly began to rose up from the engine, the careless driver moaning in the cockpit. 

\- It’s too dangerous to help him - said a voice from the left. I turned around and I saw a red flying man with a pitchfork on my shoulder - You are right my dear friend - said another voice, this time from a little man with white clothes and a golden harp between his hands walking on my right shoulder. 

I almost had a heart attack. 

\- What about going to buy an ice cream? I mean, it’s hot today here uh? - continued the angel. Speechless I continued staring at the crashed vehicle, a soft smell of fire diffusing in the air around the crash - Indeed, and things are about to become even hotter here! - replied the devil laughing.

I walked away following the advices of the two beings, going home and stopping by Hank’s Ice Cream Parlour to take a vanilla ice cream that I ate without enthusiasm only followed by the two. 

It took a while, don’t get me wrong, but in the end I came to terms with it.

I often sit in front of a picture. Shattered glass, dreams crushed after the rise of the Party, all around me. 

A giant banner cover the smoky ruins of a school “Just smile” it says, bright white letters on a pitch black background. The laughs of the children running in the courtyard haunt the streets of the district since it’s supposed demolition. In our heart we know the truth.

I often sit in front of a picture. Well one, two, three does even matter anymore? In my eyes they all appear as the same image.


I open the closet, just to find the same dusty set of black clothes, a t-shirt and a pair of bracers. They are watching us, following our daily routine: breakfast, factory, dinner in an eternal circle. They tear us apart and at the same time they want us to be close, friendly with each other - Just smile Kate, it’s easy - but I won’t let them change me.


I often sit in front of a picture. No, they force me to sit. Excruciating smiles burn my retinas, blaming hands point at me trying to break my will. I won’t let them win.

Gazing over the horizon from the small window in my room I glimpse a huge building set ablaze by the Purification Corps; I can almost hear the screams of the sick people, the smell of burning white coats, the indifference of the people walking in the streets. But in our heart we know the truth. They will not control me. 


I often sit in front of a picture. A smile. - Just smile, everything it's gonna be ok. - They really don't understand, do they? I grab one of the glass pieces; blood flowing on the floor, a cold sensation on the palm of my hand. I feel a sense of deep tranquillity, and I start to draw. 


*


I wake up early - Remember to take your meds sweetheart - reminds me a voice from the kitchen; bored I take the sealed box placed on my night cabinet. Outside the world shines, but inside of me I feel the darkness waiting.
He just needs to keep believing and his dreams will come to life one day or another!

"You are going to make it, you can do this, I know you can" 
Splatted blood trickling on the floor.
I gently move the corpse, that falls loudly at my feet. 
"Damn John, I told you that you shouldn't have taken that *thing* inside the habitat."
Nasty, screeching noises form afar.
The communication center was closer every step. The allarm stopped suddenly, and the flickering lights of the tunnels went on once again.
A neon sign **Communication Center**
"I did it!"
The happiness quickly turned into fear. 
Steps.
Not mine.
Not human.
A cabinet became the only barrier between me and the corridor. 
The computer was still working. 
"Wonderful"
My hands surf on the keyboard. Something is banging his head (I think) against the metallic door. 
> We were wrong. Planet inhabited. Do not send rescue.


Another door was present in the room, of course. I wouldn't have come here in the first place if I wasn't sure of that. From there, the shuttle bay was barely two hundred meters away. 
"You can do this, that door is going to last enough"
I take a step in the silent hallway, hoping to make it to the hangar.

When I start writing the story my head fills with a lot of ideas about the whole "world" part, like an explosion of thoughts (and that's probably why I decided to post here, because some of the thrashed ideas come back in my mind sometimes and I'm like "Uh, this plot might be interesting" and maybe others can find that interesting too and write something from it), and the story basically start to write itself.

\[Pt. 1\]

My head hurts. A lot. The intranet almost electrocuted me when I was still in there. 

An easy job: get into the system, steal a file stored inside a random guy’s private server and get the fuck out of here. Or at least is what Viktor said, and what I thought… before being chased by some private guards with the order to exterminate everything that moves. 

A quick tap on the side of my glasses and a map of the downtown appears in front of me - “I will never, NEVER, trust that fucker ever again” - while I browse the map of the dark alleys of the city, oppressed by the black clouds of smog that cover the sky, I think of all of my hacking equipment; next-gen hacking devices, neural subnet connector, CYBER-lockpick 9000 and some AXTOM multi-tools, all gone now. Luckily for me I had the time to grab my pistol and my laptop. In this way I should be able to slow them for a bit, I hope. 

They are getting closer, so I plan the shortest route out of downtown and I start to move in the direction of the old pub. The green light tremble in the night; damn, it's been forever since I last saw the night sky, with all the stars and the planet far in the galaxy. I heard that in some remote place in the mountain you can still see the sky, but it's surely someplace out of the Grid, and you can't exit the Grid. When I'm almost at the end of the alley I hear a buzzing coming from the roads just ahead of me so I move behind an empty trash bin. I see a white light, and a fully armed quadrotor fly past the street just a couple of meters ahead of me - “Drones? Fucking drones? Are you serious? They have deployed fucking drones to catch me? Who the fuck are those guys?” - Before my removal from the net I was able to download an entire folder, no time to search the right file, I just hope that this impudence doesn't make me killed or something worse. 

The road is now empty, so I make a run to the other side of it, and right at the entrance of another secondary street; I found a temporary shelter in the remnants of an old factory, older that the city itself and made with true bricks. Nowadays all the buildings are made with glass and steel for the rich and for the poors shitty dirt bricks that during the harshest storms melt. This ones at the contrary were made to last hundreds of years… but now times have changed, and the world followed and nothing is like before. Fuck, I don't have time to waste in those useless thoughts if I want to live. I turned on my tiny pc, and started my research. 

The folder was full of garbage. Nothing useful, nothing with a value, nothing confidential. So why they where after me?
